digest.component_or_area: src/rebar/llm/capabilities — model capability overrides and output mode routing
propositions: native_structured_output is blanket-disabled for Claude via _REBAR_OVERRIDES family default, but E1 measured specific Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6, haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0) with extended thinking support native structured output wire-legally

native_output_with_thinking field is omitted from three ModelCapabilities construction sites (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback path, _intersect_capabilities), so overrides setting native_output_with_thinking: True are silently dropped and output_mode routes PromptedOutput instead of NativeOutput

plumbing must be added to all three construction sites to propagate native_output_with_thinking from overrides to output_mode, and _intersect_capabilities must conservatively intersect the field across FallbackModel chain candidates using all(...)

the two measured Bedrock cells must gain _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES rows scoped to exact model ids with account/region context, while Bedrock opus-4-7/4-8 remain fail-closed (server-side rejection under thinking) and unmeasured non-Bedrock cells stay PromptedOutput
